svg.title: Heats of solution of LiCl from SVNA Fig. 12.14
svg.text: Heats of solution of LiCl from SVNA Fig. 12.14
ΔH̃ at 25 °C per mol LiCl against ñ (log scale), attached to the paper; LiCl(s) curve highlighted, redrawn
ñ, moles of H₂O per mole of solute
Feed, 10 wt% LiCl: ñ = 21.18; go up from 21.18 on the log axis to the LiCl(s) curve …
… and across to the ΔH̃ axis: ΔH̃ ≈ −34.9 kJ per mol LiCl.
Product, 40 wt% LiCl: ñ = 3.53, near the start of the curve (it begins at ñ ≈ 3); go up to the curve …
… and across: ΔH̃ ≈ −23.4 kJ per mol LiCl.
The LiCl(s) curve starts at ñ ≈ 3 (saturation); the upper curve is HCl(g), not used here.
Redrawn from SVNA Fig. 12.14 (digitized curves); in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
